summary: First full test of BELMONTE MOBI. Backend: 19 pytest cases, 15 pass / 4 fail (all 4 are real defects). MAIN E2E flow PASSES end-to-end in UI (390x844): client register -> transporte with Nominatim autocomplete + estimate -> SOLICITAR -> driver login/online toggle/sees request -> ACEITAR -> INICIAR SERVIÇO/CHEGUEI/INICIAR VIAGEM/FINALIZAR -> client tracking polls every 5s (verified live: searching->accepted->heading) -> 4-star rating (driver 14->15 ratings) -> payment+commission (10% transporte, 12% encomenda) recorded -> admin dashboard/corridas/relatórios show it. Also passed: delivery create/track/deliver with wrong(400)/correct(200) code, viagem + à disposição (hours) ride creation, tourism chips/detail/date/time/people stepper -> 'Reserva confirmada' card, admin Preços save persists and changes estimate, admin create package, clientes search + block (login -> 403), role protection (client/driver -> 403 on /api/admin/*), cancellation fee after accept, pending driver UI card + online 403. Bugs found: pending (unapproved) driver CAN accept rides/deliveries via API; delivery_code leaked on public tracking + to driver; driver can accept multiple concurrent jobs at API level; encomenda price ignores distance (always 0 km); viagem ida/volta not priced; quick-route chips don't set origin. No deprecated Expo packages detected (no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch). SafeAreaView comes from react-native-safe-area-context (OK).

critical.issue: auth.get_approved_driver (auth.py:148) only rejects 'blocked'; a PENDING/REJECTED driver gets 200 when accepting a ride (reproduced: test_unapproved_driver_cannot_accept). Must raise 403 when status != 'approved'.
Public (unauthenticated) tracking returns the 4-digit delivery_code, so anyone with the tracking code can confirm delivery. Clear pub.delivery_code in track_delivery (routers_services.py:309-317).
delivery_public() returns delivery_code to the driver, defeating the recipient confirmation code. Strip delivery_code for driver-facing responses.

build_estimate (routers_services.py:122) only routes for transporte/viagem, so encomenda always gets distance_km=0 and delivery_per_km is never applied (Belmonte->Porto Seguro 74km delivery = R$8,80).

minor.issue: No server-side check for driver already having an active ride/delivery; driver accepted 2 rides simultaneously via API (UI disables button, but API must enforce).
round_trip (ida e volta) has no effect on price; EstimateIn has no round_trip field and compute_price ignores it. Same price R$180,56 one-way vs round trip.
Cancellation fee is recorded as payment with 100% commission and is counted in admin 'Faturamento total'; driver gets 0. Confirm business rule.
Unblocking a previously APPROVED driver resets status to 'pending' (requires re-approval). Confirm intended.

ui_bugs.issue: Chip 'Belmonte → Porto Seguro' only fills destination (pickDestination); origin stays empty and estimate shows 'Preencha os dados'. Should also set origin to Belmonte.
Selecting 'Ida e volta' does not change estimate (backend ignores round_trip).
Estimate shows '0 km' for any route (backend bug).

issues: 'Centro Histórico de Belmonte' uses a Rio de Janeiro (Pão de Açúcar) photo; 'Passeio de Escuna no Rio Jequitinhonha' uses an alpine lake/mountain photo - not relevant to Belmonte-BA. Replace with coastal/Bahia imagery.
driver-online-switch is 40x20px (touch target < 44px); make the whole online card pressable
RECUSAR only hides request in local state (lost on reload)
Cancel dialog says 'Pode haver taxa' but doesn't show the fee amount (R$10) when driver already accepted
Specific street query ('Rua Doutor Gileno Amado Belmonte') returned 0 options; only generic 'Belmonte Bahia' worked - consider bounded/viewbox Nominatim search or fallback message

action_items: auth.get_approved_driver: raise 403 unless ddoc.status == 'approved' (fixes pending driver accepting/advancing rides & deliveries)
Hide delivery_code in /api/deliveries/track/{code} and in driver-facing delivery responses (/driver/available, /driver/jobs, accept/collect/transit)
build_estimate: compute route for 'encomenda' too so delivery_per_km applies
Support round_trip in EstimateIn/compute_price (e.g. x2 or configurable) and pass it from create_ride
accept_ride/accept_delivery: reject (409) if driver already has an active ride or delivery
trips/new quick chips: also set origin to Belmonte
Replace irrelevant tourism photos (Rio de Janeiro / alpine lake)
critical_code_review_comments: routers_services.py:371 'if vset and vset' duplicated condition
src/components/admin.tsx:260 settings save uses parseFloat(...) || 0 - empty field silently saves 0 price
Driver profile update accepts raw dict body (routers_services.py:351) instead of the existing DriverProfileUpdate Pydantic model
deliver_delivery takes raw dict instead of DeliverIn model
backend .env var used by frontend is EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL (not EXPO_BACKEND_URL) - tests read it into EXPO_BACKEND_URL

context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend && export EXPO_BACKEND_URL=$(grep EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL /app/frontend/.env | cut -d= -f2) && python -m pytest tests/test_belmonte_api.py -n 0 (pytest.ini adds xdist; tests are order-dependent so use -n 0). Ratings service_type is 'ride'/'delivery'/'booking'. Tourism routes under /api/tourism/*. AddressInput option testID: <input>-option-<lat>; query 'Belmonte Bahia' / 'Porto Seguro Bahia' reliably return options.
rca_of_issue: Pending driver accept: get_approved_driver name implies approval check but only checks 'blocked'; set_online does its own status check, so only /driver/online is protected. Delivery 0 km: is_route_service = service_type in ('transporte','viagem') excludes 'encomenda'.
